book.name: Jön
book.title: Jön Jöntho Fatmata ogepma irim togoc

content: Yesu yu Yuda nanohon bongono moröma acacha Yerusalem onggoc
Oro Yuda nanohon amna dugo yu Yesu wot omom toctocha yong torop sigung. Worocha tongga Yesu yu Yudia gurocin manggoc. Muno, yui Galili gurocingon itonggoc.
Woce itongga idina urop Yuda nanohon bongono morö eng teboc. Bongono wocin wömai Yuda nanoho Kopotoroc yu sa amna maiyan woce ogepgon yangtoregocma worocha kombingga tac böc tobingga wocin ididung.
Oro bongono worocho eng teuna Yesuhon orugiho engmuya Yesu inogung, “Goc muyu sa ngo imi fauna Yudia sadec ongoi. Ongiya owi amna gocha kombiangma yu gochon youp foro au woroc aup.

Amna au yu suraro ambarachon amna iditha kombinggai wömai yu youpno owi amna ambaracho yangamin eran tuna anung, öpgon muno. Worocha goc muyu eran idiya owi amna sa guroc danong yu gochon toroc kiap inobaracma wo yanahing.”
Yesuhon orugi yu wömai Yesu ihoroc makombing tobing imogung. Worocha yu mata ihoroc yogung.
Ihoroc yuya Yesuho mata ingoroc iban imogoc, “Nandöngnaho abe ‘woce ongoi’ mananogoc mahong sonu wömai soniin irot tanto bongono muno woce woce ongup.
Kombiang, guroc owi amna yu son ayam matong kamoning. Worochoi nocu wömai toroc wöntuc-muno tongidangma wo eran tong indaaya ec imuya ayam tong namongidang.
Son bongono moröma acacha Yerusalem ongurit. Nochon youp toctochon bongono abe maecmaha nocu woce mangit.”
Yesu mata ihoroc inongga Galili torengga idoc.
Worochoi oro orugiho ongdeng idiya Yesu yu ‘owi amnaho naningyit’ yongo ihorocgon öpgon bongono moröma acacha Yerusalem onggoc.
Tuna Yuda nanohon amna dugo yu ‘Yesu sogitna’ yongo yuha gön tongga idung. Tongo yu owi amna inongo yac tongga inogung, “Amna wo nahe itac yo?”
Ihoroc yuya owi amna komongno yui Yesuha mata koböc yong tonggung. Auho wömai yogung ‘yui amna ogepma’, o auho yogung ‘muno, yu suraro inong yungitac’.
Yu ihoroc yong tonggung mahong suraroho amna dugoha botogungmaha yu eran mayogung, muno öpgon yogung.
Oro bongono moröma worochon sep youp toctoc au bödeuna Yesu yu öret socsoc böchon gombo ganang öngmuna foro singga owi amna fatmata fandat inogoc.
Ihoroc tuna Yuda nanoho matano kombingga soroc yongga yogung, “Mayain, amna ngomai osuc kombic kombic bucin bongono docutnogon ögoc. Yu kombic kombic ogepma sinom nahema sogidoc?”

Ihoroc yuya Yesuho mata ökene ingoroc iban imogoc, “Nocu mata fandat kanongitatma woi nakain kombic kombicha muno. Amna noc nanong muuna ebotma yuhon kombic kombicgon wömai nocho sindanda fandat kanongitat.
Amna au yu ‘Kopotorochon irot koing soun’ yongo kombihacma yu wömai tuctugo kombiantac, nocho Kopotorochon mata yong fandaditatha woha noc nakain kombic kombicnagon tanitat.

“Amna au yu inoin kombic kombicdecma mata yontacma yu wömai inoin mano töctöcha yontac. Wohong amna au yu amna inongmuuna ebocma yuhon irot koing soun yongo kombihacma yu woi amna nongnongo. Yudec wömai imanang au maec.
Kombiarut, Möse yu wömai nongoru mata kamogoc mahong son ambaracho nongoruhon toroc maitongidang. Worocha sonu foro yaöha noc not omompha yong torop siang?”
Yesuho ihoroc inuna suraroho mamboda yogung, “Dogu boyömo au gocdec idina bumbum yarochu? Amna au goc got omompha maying.”
Ihoroc yuya Yesuho inogoc, “Nocho Sabat bongonodec amna tungu ta orokuna irot soni obukogung.

Kombiarut, son ihorocgon Sabat bongonodec managumbochon godibo mangidang. Ombusakung soni yu osucgon managumbochon godibo mangidung. Tuya Möse yu godip macmachon nongoru kamuna son Sabat bongo-nodechu o bongono munohu managumbochon godibo mangidang.

Oro sonu Sabat bongonodec managumbochon godibo mauya Mösehon nongoru mayembodidang. Worocha tongga nocho ihorocgon Sabat bongonodec amnahon godip föp ambarac ta orokun. Sonu worocha nocha ececgo kombininga.
Son nochon toroc kiap danthogon angsoworeninga, son muyu nochon toroc kiap irotho kiapmodec nongnongogon angsoworearut.” Yesu yu ihoroc yogoc.
Yesu yu numa sinom
Oro Yesuho mata ihoroc yongbödeuna Yerusalem owi amna au yu Yesuha inohogon inun ganun tongga yogung, “Tingting sinom? Amna dugo noniho amna wot omom toctocha yogungma woi amna worochu?
Yu suraroho yangamin eran idongga fatmata fandat inongitac mahong amna dugo yu ‘öpgon itun’ yongo maying. Amna dugo noni yu amna worocha kombiang yu Duic, ihorochu nuhun.
Muno woi, Duic ino boinno ehunai wömai amna au yuhon böcsano makombining mahong nonu yuhon böcno sanoi tuctugo kombiamon.”

Yerusalem owi amna yu mata mata ihoroc yongga idiya Yesu yu öret socsoc bucin itmuna ingoroc mambodoc: “Boinno, sonu nakahu o nochon böcna sana wömai kombiang mahong amna noc nanong muuna ebotma yu wömai makombing iming. Yuhon toroc kiapmo woi boinno orin nongnongogon.
Sonu yu makombing iming mahong nocu yu kombing impat. Nocho yuot edeya yuho noc nanong muuna ebot.”
Yesu mata woroc yongbödeuna owi amnaho kombingga ec imogung. Tongo yu Yesu sogit akep toctocha kombigung mahong Yesuhon bongono abe mafom togocmaha amnaho botongga sogit akep matogung.

Wohong owi amna torop au yu wömai Yesu kombing tobing imongo yogung, “Duicho enggai wömai yu toroc kiap amna ngorocho tongitacma wo yanggiraangochu? Muno, amna ngorocho toroc kiap inobarac sinom tongitac, yu ino woi Duic.”

Oro suraro au yu ihoroc yongga idiya Farisiho mata woroc kombingga ‘sogit akep tona’ yongo öret socsoc böchon amna dugo inongburoc togung. Tuya yu tawa amna inong muuya yu Yesu sogito akep toctocha onggung.
Ihoroc tongga idiya Yesu yu abe suraroho yangamin itmuna yong fandat inongga yogoc, “Nocu bongono docutnogon sonot itmaina son dongya fauya Nandöngot ongöngot. Yu nanong muuna ebot.
Sonu nocha yabinahing mahong mananing. O sa nocho engotan woce sonu angit mangoning.”

Yesuho ihoroc yuna Yuda nanoho kombiu tuctuc mayuna inohogon inun ganun tongo yogung, “Yu sa nahenne onggonga yac yo, nontho yu woce maanin? Yu sa korungon ongga Grik nano yong fandat inoc inocha yachu nuhun?
O tingtinga yu yogoc, ‘Sonu nocha yabinahing mahong mananing. O sa nocho engotan woce sonu angit mangoning’ mata ngorochon foro wömai nonu angit makombimon.”
Yesuho yamuc itonggongnobarac worochon mata yogoc

Oro bongono moröma ngorochon bödec bödecnodec wömai sep youp toctoc bongono madango moröma sinom ididoc. Sep bongono wocin Yesuho idongga ecnang ingoroc yogoc, “Amna au yu yamucha kombinggai wömai yu nocot engmuna yamuc nahun.

Owi amna noc kombing tobing namonahingma worocho irotnon wömai yamuc itonggongnobarac sunda moröma fada ongontac. Kopotorochon bapiyadec worochon yong tuctuc mata irim toctocyi itac. Tuna mata worocho boinno engoc.”

Yesuho mata tepmo ngo yogocma wömai Kopotorocho Kunkun Yaru kombing tobic tobic owi amna sing imangocma worocha yogoc. Bongono wocin wömai Yesu abe Kopotorocot mangi ida yaguno idit kiap abe masogidoc. Worocha tongga Kunkun Yaruho abe mahogoc.
Suraroho Yesuha fuc tongmuya torop koböc idung
Oro suraro yu Yesuhon mata wo kombingmuya auho yogung, “Amna wo yu boinno sinom Kopotorochon yong tuctuc amna moröma.”
Ihoroc yuya torop auho wömai yogung, “Muno, amna ngoi Duic woroc.” Ihoroc yuya auho yogung, “Muno, Duic yui Galili sadec maöngkuic.
Kopotorochon bapiyaho yac, Duic yu king Devithon toropdec Betlehem bucin öngkuangoc. Taun wocin wömai Devitho osuc ididoc.”
Oro suraroho Yesuha mata koböc koböc ihoroc yong tongmuya fuc tongga torop koböc idung.
Tuna auho Yesu yi bucin sicsichontha yogung mahong yu ambarac botongga tu matogoc.
Yuda nanohon amna moröma yu Yesu makombing tobing imogung

Oro suraroho ihoroc yong tongga idiya tawa amnaho Yesu sogit akep toctocha ebungma yu tu matuna ibaru fauna öret socsoc böchon amna dugo orin Farisi yuot onggung. Onguya amna dugoho yu inong yac tongga yogung, “Sonu foro yaha Yesu mayangat tehing?”
Ihoroc yuya tawa amnaho mata ökene iban imongga yogung, “Amna wo yui mata inobarac sinom ninongitac. Amna auho osuc mata ihoroc mayogung.”
Ihoroc yuya Farisiho koroc koroc imuya inogung, “Mayain, yu son ihorocgon kanong yuhachu yo?
Kombiarut, non amna dugohu o Farisihu nonthon torop nonidecma amna tungu au Yesuha makombing tobing imoc.
Muno sinom owi amna bumbumyi yuhogon wömai kombing tobing imongidang. Yu wömai nongoru mata makombiing. Kopotorocho yu möpmo wagang imuna gorong ongonahing.”

Amna moröma yu ihoroc yongga itmuya amna au mano Nikodemus yu ihorocgon woce idoc. Yu woi osuc Yesuot onguna mata yogomoroc. Yu woi ihorocgon Farisihon toropdecma. Amna wo yu idongga amna dugo inogoc,

“Tingting oro, nongoru noniho ingoroc yachu: Non ogep amna au foro muno matano yana bödeuntha woha muno? Muno sinom, non muyu osuc yuhon duc mata kombingga youpnohon foro angsoworengga mit wömai matano yana bödehun.”
Ihoroc yuna amna dugoho kombiuya angit maidina inogung, “Tingting oro, goc ihorocgon Galili amnahu? Goc Kopotorochon bapiya sogitmina embahi. Yong tuctuc amna au yu Galili sae maöngkuic.”
Ihoroc yongbödengga mit amna moröma ambaracho inoin inoin böcnon onggung.
